name: Hänsel
source:
The Optimistic Brother

One of famiglia Grimm's caporegimes and Gretel's twin brother. He's belligerent and an extreme optimist who will take anything but total failure as encouragement. In a fight, he’ll throw sticks of dynamite left and right.

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/ozmafia/]English official website[/url].]
